ambiguities_declared: The controlled relation vocabulary (has-mcl, has-mclg, has-mrdl, has-mrdlg, requires-monitoring, compliance-basis, applies-to, defined-as, requires-treatment-technique) has no term specifically for notice-delegation or responsibility-retention provisions; 'applies-to' and 'compliance-basis' were selected as closest fits rather than exact matches.

challenge_questions.expected_answer: Yes, the primacy agency may give the notice required by this subpart on behalf of the owner and operator of the public water system, if the primacy agency complies with the requirements of this subpart.
challenge_questions.question: Can the primacy agency issue required public notices on behalf of a water system instead of the water system doing it directly?

challenge_questions.expected_answer: Yes. The owner or operator of the public water system remains responsible for ensuring that the requirements of this subpart are met.
challenge_questions.question: If the primacy agency gives the public notice on behalf of the water system, is the water system still responsible for compliance?
